primary_classes.EOS_CANDIDATE_BUDGET_PRUNED: EOS retained but max_completed_candidates was already reached.
primary_classes.EOS_COMPLETED: EOS retained by frozen policy and appended as a completed candidate.
primary_classes.EOS_FRONTIER_FLOOR_RESTORED_AND_COMPLETE: EOS was restored only by the existing frontier floor then completed.
primary_classes.EOS_MAX_NEW_TOKENS_BLOCKED: EOS was unavailable because the frozen max_new_tokens boundary was reached.
primary_classes.EOS_OTHER_PRUNED: Reserved only for future source-supported EOS states; not fabricated by this runner.
primary_classes.EOS_POLICY_PRUNED: EOS legal but absent after frozen retention and frontier-floor resolution.
